metadata.host_selection_rule: storage-only: direct child contract with most references; lexical canonical-id tie-break

semantics.semantic_rule: Protocol representation maps to canonical operation/data semantics owned elsewhere.
semantics.removable_rule: Optional protocol adapter can be absent without deleting the underlying canonical semantic owner.
semantics.authority_rule: Protocol reachability does not grant operation/data authority.
semantics.identity_rule: Protocol endpoint/address is a binding, not canonical semantic identity.
semantics.translation_rule: Protocol-specific encoding/decoding must preserve declared semantic distinctions.
semantics.error_rule: Canonical validation/authorization errors remain distinguishable through protocol error mapping.

invariants.rule: Protocols expose or transport canonical operations/data but never become semantic owner or bypass canonical authority.

hard_gates.condition: protocol adapter owns duplicated business semantics
removing adapter deletes underlying semantic definition
protocol encoding collapses required semantic distinctions
transport address used as semantic identity
